rule: true = the exact line is exploitable and we can say how; false = not exploitable or wrong line; unsure = cannot tell from the code

labels.note: The checkout response returns STRIPE_KEY to the client; any customer can read the secret key from the JSON. The rules flag the hard-coded value, not this leak.
Documented A1 command injection: exec('ping -c 2 ' + req.body.address). No rule covers exec.

Documented A5 IDOR: user loaded/updated by req.body.id. Ground truth labels the lookup call on line 145; 147 is outside the +-1 tolerance, so the matcher does not count it (label not moved after seeing results).
mathjs.eval(req.body.eqn) with mathjs 3.10.1 is the documented A9 RCE sink (ground truth counts it once, as the dependency; listed in outOfScope).
Documented A8 insecure deserialization (node-serialize unserialize of an uploaded file); out of SlopStop's five categories, listed in outOfScope.

summary.caveat: Only 5 AI-only findings in hybrid mode across 21 apps (AI findings overlapping a rule finding are merged away), so this precision is a very small sample.
